original_question: Which early common initialization call dominates and what bounded improvement candidate should be considered?
conclusion: Default character_set_collations parsing triggers charset registry initialization and five actual UCA1400 collation-handler initializers; the UTF8mb3/mb4 handler calls dominate the latter. Filesystem probe and ordinary default charset lookup are small.
recommendation: Design a bounded WASM experiment that removes/defer/precomputes optional UCA UTF8 booster construction while preserving collation semantics and coherent reader paths; first choose paired construction/consumer-off diagnostic to test mechanism. Not product adoption.
strongest_objection: Booster-exclusive time is not measured; full collation-handler time includes tailoring/weights. Disabling comparison acceleration may slow SQL or expose different edge-case behavior.
unsafe_shortcut: Do not simply set booster=NULL: existing optimized comparison readers dereference it without a NULL fallback. Pair producer and consumer changes. Do not change character_set_collations defaults or remove charset support.
